cultivation.murimblock.bottleneck: Your Qi presses against the gate of %s. Meditate with at least 80% of your Qi and hold [%s] for seven seconds: in your inner world, the old master will offer you the trial
cultivation.murimblock.deviation: Your Qi deviates: Qi Max lost, the reserve gone, your body weakened for a while
cultivation.murimblock.inner.reserve: Your Qi must be at least 80% full to open your inner world
cultivation.murimblock.inner.arrived: You open your eyes in your inner world. Speak to the remnant soul; hold the meditation key to return
cultivation.murimblock.inner.demon: Your Heart Demon rises: all your strength, your art, your blood. Its blows weigh %s%%. Defeat it to break through; it wins, and your Qi deviates
cultivation.murimblock.inner.gate: Your Qi presses against the gate of your realm. The old master is waiting for you
cultivation.murimblock.inner.demon_slain: Your Heart Demon dissolves. The gate opens...
cultivation.murimblock.inner.torn_out: Your body was struck: you are torn out of your inner world
cultivation.murimblock.pill.poisoned: Too much toxicity: the pill poisons you
cultivation.murimblock.pill.breaking: Your next Heart Demon will be weaker (toxicity %s)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.busy.storm: Remnant Soul: "The scattered Qi will not wait. Gather it."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.busy.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "Your shadow is waiting for you."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.tomorrow: Remnant Soul: "Enough for today. Rest, and come back tomorrow."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.start.storm: Mission: gather the scattered Qi within a minute (+%s Qi Max)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.start.sparri: Mission: beat your shadow (+%s Qi Max)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.done.storm: Remnant Soul: "Good. Your Qi is whole again." +%s Qi Max
cultivation.murimblock.soul.done.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "You beat yourself. Remember how." +%s Qi Max
cultivation.murimblock.soul.lost.storm: Remnant Soul: "Too slow: %s of %s. Tomorrow, perhaps."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.lost.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "Your shadow won. Rest, then try again."
dialogue.murimblock.soul.first: So... you finally opened your eyes in here. Do not be afraid, child. I have dwelt in your dantian since long before you knew you had one.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.greet: You came back. Good. %s %s... Your Qi is steadier than last time. What do you seek?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.menu: What else do you wish to know?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.who: Once I had a name, a sect and a sword. Now I am only what remains of a master who reached too far. You may call me Sensei.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.past: At the gate of a great realm, my Heart Demon rose. It had my strength, my art, every trick I knew. I hesitated; it did not. My Qi tore my body apart, and this remnant fled into you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.where: Your inner world. This island is your dantian made visible: it grows as you grow, and it bears the marks of your art and of your failures.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.farewell: Go. And do not neglect your breathing.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.storm: Your Qi lies scattered over the island like leaves after a storm. Gather every mote within a minute. (+%s Qi Max)
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.sparring: Spar with your shadow. It is only half of you, but it fights the way you do. Learn your own habits. (+%s Qi Max)
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.none: Enough for today. Qi gathered in haste scatters. Rest, and come back tomorrow.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.gate: Your Qi can grow no more in this realm. Only the gate is left.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.begin.storm: Go. Before the wind takes them.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.begin.sparring: Face it. And watch what it does better than you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.busy.storm: The scattered Qi will not wait for you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.busy.sparring: Your shadow is waiting. Do not keep it waiting.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.resume: Then stop talking to an old ghost.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.given_up: Hm. Nothing gained, nothing lost. Try again when your mind is clear.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.toxic: Your meridians reek of pills. Elixirs force the Qi in; they do not make it yours. Let them clear before you take another.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.place: Your body sits where the Qi runs thin. Meditate in the Murim lands, on a high peak, or near the sanctuary of the Cloud Cliff, and it will gather far faster.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.gate: A new realm draws near. When your Qi presses against its gate, come to me: there is a trial no one passes unprepared.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.roads: Three roads lead up. Sit and condense your Qi every day. Spend it in battle, for Qi that is used grows. And swallow elixirs, sparingly.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.gate: Your Qi presses against the walls of %s. I felt it the moment you arrived.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.gate.again: The walls of %s will not hold your Qi much longer.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.beyond: Beyond lies %s. But no one passes that gate untested. It is guarded by the one who knows you best: yourself.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.myself: Your Heart Demon. It will have your blood, your strength, your art, every move you know. Not a hair less. Only your heart can differ.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.prepare: Its strength is yours, but its blows land as hard as your doubts. Meditate in a place of power, take a Realm-Breaking Pill, carry no poison. As you are today, its blows would land at %s%% of their weight.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.warn: Once it rises, there is no walking away. Flee, and your Qi turns on you. Fall, and it scatters. Are you certain?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.trial.now: Do not look at me. Look at it!
dialogue.murimblock.soul.not_yet: Wise. The gate will not move. Come back when your heart is still.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.answer.resume: I am going back to it.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.answer.ready: I am ready to face myself.
item.murimblock.peak_captain_spawn_egg: Captain of the Peak Guard Spawn Egg
item.murimblock.son_of_the_demon_spawn_e: Son of the Demon Spawn Egg
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.f: The old man opens his eyes. They glow jade, then settle. "Few climb this far without being called. Sit, if you like. The mountain does not mind, and neither do I."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.g: "You again. The clouds told me you were coming; they gossip."
He does not look up. "Speak. I have been listening to the mountain since before your grandfather's grandfather. It can wait."
"The wind smells of iron today. Someone in the Murim is fighting. Someone always is. What do you want, little one?"
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.w: "Who am I? A guest of this sanctuary. An old man who meditates. That is what the disciples say, and they are not wrong."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.d: For a moment the light in the hall turns gold, and something vast seems to breathe behind him. Then it is gone. "Stories. The Murim loves its stories."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.p: "The Cloud Cliff Sanctuary. Built on a peak the dragons once slept on, by people who thought height was the same as wisdom. They were half right."
"Gather Qi. Fight, and lose, and fight again. Break through when your body begs you to stop. There is no other road, only longer and shorter ones."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.m: "And when you meet your Heart Demon, do not hate it. It is the only one in the Murim who knows you completely."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.w: "The Murim is not the only world. Below it burns a realm of fire and ash. Beyond the sky lies a void where the stars have gone out. Men have walked into both. Fewer walked out."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.m: "I can fold a talisman that opens the way, once. It remembers where you stood, and carries you back when you call on it again. Then it is ash. Each costs %s gold yuanbao: the Qi I put in it is not cheap. They are on my scroll, with the rest."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.f: "Go well. The mountain will still be here. So will I."
dialogue.murimblock.golden_dragon_sage.a: People speak of a golden dragon on this mountain.
What do you have to offer?
Can you open the way for me?
item.murimblock.crossing_talisman.unboun: Hold to cross over. Hold again to come back.
item.murimblock.crossing_talisman.bound: Remembers where you came from. Hold to return.
message.murimblock.crossing_talisman.her: You are already in this world.
message.murimblock.crossing_talisman.bou: The talisman remembers where you stood.
gui.murimblock.sage_shop.title: Treasures of the Golden Dragon
gui.murimblock.sage_shop.motto: "A guide to every road, a door to every world."
item.murimblock.martial_guide.hint: Read it, and it tells you the way
item.murimblock.martial_guide.other_worl: The guide only shows the way within the Murim
guide.murimblock.long_fist.page.0:
LONG FIST

The first art of the fist: steady breath, honest blows. Tiger Step Punch, Rapid Fists, Whirlwind Kick.

Difficulty: one drop of ink. Bare hands.
guide.murimblock.long_fist.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

The Alliance Merchant sells its scroll for 40 silver taels, in every Alliance outpost and arena.

Mountain bandits and their chiefs carry it too, and it hides in the caches of old sites.
guide.murimblock.long_fist.page.2:
THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Alliance Outpost, and how far.

A beginner's art. Start here.
guide.murimblock.golden_bell.page.0:
GOLDEN BELL

The guardian monks' art: do not strike first. Take the blow, hold, send it back. Golden Bell, Iron Rebound, Rooted Mountain.

Difficulty: one drop of ink. Bare hands.
guide.murimblock.golden_bell.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

The Golden Bell monk keeps its sutra in the middle court of the temple of the Sea of Bamboo, by the taiji. He sells it for 40 silver taels.

Speak to him; he is a warrior too.
guide.murimblock.golden_bell.page.2:
THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Misty Bamboo Daoist Temple, and how far.

A beginner's art, for one who would rather endure.
guide.murimblock.traveller_staff.page.0:
TRAVELLER'S STAFF

The art of the long road, with a staff in both hands. Third Resonance, Vertical Strike, Flurry of Points, Spinning Rampart.

Difficulty: one drop of ink.
guide.murimblock.traveller_staff.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

The Alliance Merchant sells its scroll for 40 silver taels, in every Alliance outpost and arena.

Mountain bandits sometimes carry one.
guide.murimblock.traveller_staff.page.2:
THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Alliance Outpost, and how far.

Buy a traveller's staff while you are there.
guide.murimblock.celestial_peak_spear.pa:
CELESTIAL PEAK SPEAR

The Alliance's spear: long reach, sweeping thrusts, a guard no one walks through.

Difficulty: two drops of ink.

WHERE IT IS KEPT

Only the Peak Captain teaches it, and only to one who defeats him. He waits on the leitai of the Alliance Arena.

No merchant sells it.

THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Alliance Arena, and how far.

Learn to parry before you climb his stage.
AZURE CLOUD SWORD

The Azure Cloud's sword: Cloud Step Slash, Thousand Drizzle, the crescent that falls from the sky.

Difficulty: three drops of ink.

WHERE IT IS KEPT

Sensei Yun keeps its manual in the Hall of the Three Pure Ones, in the temple of the Sea of Bamboo. He gives it only to one who defeats him.

He is strong, and he does not tire.

THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Misty Bamboo Daoist Temple, and how far.

Bring a sword, and patience.
guide.murimblock.mountain_shattering_fis:
MOUNTAIN-SHATTERING FIST

The Bandit Warlord's fist: blows that crack the earth and send men flying.

Difficulty: four drops of ink. Read only from Qi Condensation.

WHERE IT IS KEPT

The Son of the Demon carries its scroll. Clear a great Bandit Camp, all thirty-five of its men, and the Bandit Warlord falls from the sky. Beat him, then what he becomes: the Son of the Demon.

Few walk away.

THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Bandit Camp, and how far.

Go strong, and not alone.
guide.murimblock.overlord_spear.page.0:
OVERLORD SPEAR

One does not pierce: one pulverises. Beams of Qi, cracked ground, craters, a charge that crushes against walls.

Difficulty: four drops of ink. Read from Qi Condensation.
guide.murimblock.overlord_spear.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

No one hands it over. Master the Celestial Peak Spear, the art of the Alliance Arena's captain, up to fifty, and the spear itself will want more.

The scroll comes to you then.
guide.murimblock.overlord_spear.page.2:
THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Alliance Arena, where the Celestial Peak Spear is won.

The point first. Then the weight.
SEVEN STARS SWORD

The florett that marks the stars on its foe, seven, and makes them burst.

Difficulty: four drops of ink. Read from Qi Condensation; the stars give it only at Qi Liquidation.

WHERE IT IS KEPT

No one keeps it. It waits on the summit of the Star-Plucking Peak, the highest point of the world, in the Northern snows.

Meditate there three minutes, at Qi Liquidation, and the stars give it once.

THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the summit, and how far.

The climb is long. The cold is longer.
guide.murimblock.majin_fist.page.0:
MAJIN FIST

The Son of the Demon's fist: the pride of the noon sun. Blows that burn, suns that fall, and The One.

Difficulty: four drops of ink. Read only from Qi Liquidation.
guide.murimblock.majin_fist.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

The Son of the Demon always carries its scroll. He is what the Bandit Warlord becomes when beaten, in the crater of a great Bandit Camp.

Clear the camp, beat the Warlord, then him.
guide.murimblock.majin_fist.page.2:
THE WAY

Hold this guide and read it: it writes in your mind the way to the nearest Bandit Camp, and how far.

Do not fight him at noon.
guide.murimblock.thunder_saber.target: A lightning rod under the storm
guide.murimblock.thunder_saber.way: The guide shows no road: wait for a thunderstorm, and stand beside a copper lightning rod under the open sky, a greatsword in hand. Only one who has reached Qi Crystallization is answered.
guide.murimblock.thunder_saber.page.0:
PURPLE HEAVEN THUNDER SABER

A greatsword in both hands: heavy blows beat thunder drums, and the drums call the purple lightning. Thunder Descends, Rolling Thunder, Heaven's Drum, Severing Flash, Nine Heavens' Wrath.

Difficulty: four drops of ink. Read from Qi Condensation.
guide.murimblock.thunder_saber.page.1:
WHERE IT IS KEPT

No one keeps it. The sky gives it, once, to one who has reached Qi Crystallization.

Thunder does not ask. It answers.
guide.murimblock.thunder_saber.page.2:
THE WAY

Wait for a thunderstorm. Stand beside a copper lightning rod under the open sky, a greatsword in hand, and do not move.

The bolt will not burn you.
message.murimblock.bandit_camp.cleared: The camp falls silent. Not one bandit is left standing.

message.murimblock.sensei.challenge: Sensei Yun: "The Azure Cloud is not given, it is earned. Draw your blade and take it from me, if you can."
message.murimblock.sensei.second_phase: Sensei Yun: "Enough courtesy. Now, see the Azure Cloud."
technique.murimblock.cast.not_in_combat: Enter combat mode to use your techniques
technique.murimblock.swallow_returns.dis: A swallow returns to its nest... You discovered the secret technique Swallow Returns
technique.murimblock.cloud_step_slash.de: Hold the key to aim in the draw stance, let go to dash 5 blocks through everything on the way. In the air: a dive that knocks down. As a riposte: a short dash that cuts twice.
technique.murimblock.thousand_drizzle.de: Within 3 blocks: six cuts that hold, a last one that sends flying, then every cut opens again on the body. Farther: a great ghost sword sent straight ahead. As a riposte: the last cut breaks the guard.
technique.murimblock.heaven_splitting_cr: A rising cut: you leap 7 blocks, carrying the target. Hang there 1.5 s, then press again to slam it down: the landing blasts the ground. Needs open sky. In the air: Cloud-Splitting Descent.
technique.murimblock.swallow_returns.des: Cloud Step Slash within a quarter second of a perfect parry: you appear behind the attacker and spin into a cut.
Strikes that land restore 1 Qi. A perfect parry restores 6 Qi and opens a riposte: for 1.5 s, your next technique takes its riposte form for half its Qi.
strike.murimblock.piercing_mist.desc: a long thrust with a step
strike.murimblock.rising_cloud.desc: launcher: a rising cut that lifts
strike.murimblock.falling_rain.desc: finisher: a falling cut that knocks down
strike.murimblock.wind_step.desc: a sliding step with a cut
quest.murimblock.step.patient_blade.dash: Enemies cut by Cloud Step Slash %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.sea_of_clouds.bell: Ring the bell of the sanctuary %s/%s
art.murimblock.too_weak: You are too weak to grasp %s. It can only be learnt from %s, and you are only at %s.
art.murimblock.too_weak.short: Too weak: the scroll's words slip from your mind
passive.murimblock.crimson_stance.desc: Bare-hand crimson strikes and guard. Landed M1 strikes build the blood gauge, then earn dorsal crystals while transformed.
technique.murimblock.bloodbane_drain.des: Hold to grow a blood crystal in your hand, its fragments circling it. Held longer, it draws your blood gauge into itself and grows; at a full gauge it becomes a great crystal that explodes. Release to throw it. It can be guarded or parried.
technique.murimblock.scarlet_tear.desc: A blood sword forms in your hand, piece by piece, and you fight with it as with any sword; no other technique while it is out. Press again to throw it like a javelin, point first: it explodes where it strikes. A landed throw builds 3 points toward Blood Crystal Form.
Activate at a full blood gauge. Lasts 30 seconds, in or out of combat, and reduces incoming damage by 30%. Land M1 strikes to earn up to 10 dorsal crystals.
passive.murimblock.long_reach.desc: Epic Fight's spear strikes. A hit landed with the point, 3 blocks out or more, strikes 20% harder and pushes back.
technique.murimblock.piercing_dragon.des: Lunge 4 blocks along your spear, through every enemy in its line. From the air, dive point first and pin the target to the ground.
technique.murimblock.plum_blossom_thrust: Five quick thrusts fanned out like a plum flower's petals, then a sixth that pushes back. From the air, three thrusts down and the shaft brought down.
technique.murimblock.thousand_soldier_sw: A whole turn at the knees, the spear at arm's length, knocking down everyone within 3.5 blocks. From the air, plant the spear as you land.
Hits landed at the point (Long Reach): %s/%s
art.murimblock.learned_all: You learned the %s and its techniques: %s
technique.murimblock.cast.no_staff: %s needs the Traveller's Staff in hand
passive.murimblock.third_resonance.desc: Epic Fight's staff strikes. The third strike of a chain deals double damage, whether the two before it hit or not; a chain left for 1.5 seconds starts again.
technique.murimblock.vertical_strike.des: Raise the staff over your head in both hands and bring it straight down: one hit with its top end on the first enemy 2.5 blocks ahead. Your feet stay planted.
technique.murimblock.point_flurry.desc: Five straight thrusts with the point, 3 blocks ahead: four quick ones that hold the target, a last one that pushes it back a little. A target that steps aside avoids the rest.
technique.murimblock.spinning_rampart.de: Hold the key to spin the staff before you like a propeller: every attack from the front is stopped, whatever it is, with its push and its effects. Your back stays open. 5 Qi a second, 3 seconds at most; you walk slowly and cannot jump, strike or use another technique. The cooldown starts when you let go.
technique.murimblock.tiger_step_punch.de: A low bound of 3 blocks ending in a punch that pushes back a block. In the air: a dive with a punch to the ground that knocks down.
technique.murimblock.rapid_fists.desc: Five quick punches that hold the target, then one that sends it 3 blocks back. In the air: three punches, then a hammer fist that knocks it down.
technique.murimblock.whirlwind_kick.desc: A spinning jump, leg stretched, that strikes all round you (2.5 blocks) and pushes back 3 blocks. In the air: you come down turning and strike all round as you land.
technique.murimblock.inch_force.desc: Tiger Step Punch with the target already at your fist, within a second of a perfect parry: no bound, one punch from where you stand. Everything stops a moment, then the target flies 6 blocks and stays stunned.
technique.murimblock.inch_force.discover: Power needs no distance... You discovered the secret technique Inch Force
passive.murimblock.steady_breath.desc: Bare-handed, your punches that land restore 1 Qi, and a perfect parry restores 5 Qi. Your guard holds without a weapon.
quest.murimblock.step.first_steps.tiger_: Enemies hit by Tiger Step Punch %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.unbroken_flurry.fu: Full flurries of Rapid Fists on an enemy %s/%s
passive.murimblock.pride_of_the_sun.desc: Epic Fight's bare-hand strikes. Each one that lands sets the target alight for 2 seconds. By day under the open sky, your strikes hit 15% harder.
technique.murimblock.sunfire_fist.desc: A straight right driven through: a burst of flame and sunlight before your fist strikes and burns every enemy within 2.5 blocks.
technique.murimblock.pride_flare.desc: Thrust your burning palm forward: a wave of solar flame runs 15 blocks along the ground, 4 blocks wide, striking and burning everything in its path.
technique.murimblock.cruel_sun.desc: Raise your palm and grow a small sun over it, then hurl it where you look, up to 24 blocks away: it bursts in a blast of 3.5 blocks and leaves a crater.
technique.murimblock.noon_judgment.desc: Point at the sky: golden circles appear under up to five enemies within 16 blocks, and a second later pillars of sunlight strike them.
technique.murimblock.midday_meteor.desc: Leap high and come down where you look, up to 14 blocks away: a crater where you land, a blast round you, then a ring of fire running out along the ground.
technique.murimblock.the_one.desc: A sun is born over you. For 20 seconds you are faster and stronger, enemies near you burn, and fire cannot touch you. At the end, the sun falls where you look: a blast of 7 blocks.
technique.murimblock.grand_noon.desc: Sunfire Fist cast crouching under the noon sun: a pillar of sunlight crashes down on the enemy before you.
technique.murimblock.grand_noon.discover: At noon, the sun answers the proud... You discovered the secret technique Grand Noon
quest.murimblock.step.kindling.burns: Enemies set alight by your strikes: %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.suns_wrath.hits: Enemies struck by a Cruel Sun: %s/%s
passive.murimblock.earthshaker.desc: Epic Fight's bare-hand strikes. Each one that lands shakes the ground: 30% of your attack to every enemy within 1.5 blocks of the target. Bare hands break stone and wood three times faster.
technique.murimblock.mountain_crushing_p: A straight right driven through: the target is thrown back, everything in a cone of 5 blocks is struck, and a tunnel opens 4 blocks ahead. From the air, dive fist first.
technique.murimblock.earth_breaker.desc: Both fists brought down on the ground: every enemy within 5 blocks is thrown up and slowed, and a crater opens round you. From the air, a wider crater.
technique.murimblock.bull_charge.desc: Lower your shoulder and rush ahead: every enemy in the way is knocked down, and walls burst open before you.
technique.murimblock.heaven_falling_moun: Leap into the sky, then fall like a meteor where you look, up to 12 blocks away: a crater of 8 blocks, the heart of it crushed, everyone round it thrown back and set alight.
technique.murimblock.sky_breaker.desc: Mountain-Crushing Punch cast crouching: an uppercut that throws the target high into the sky, the ground bursting under it.
technique.murimblock.sky_breaker.discove: Strike the earth hard enough and the sky will follow... You discovered the secret technique Sky Breaker
quest.murimblock.step.shake_the_earth.gr: Techniques that struck 3 enemies or more at once: %s/%s
art.murimblock.overlord_spear.enlightenm: The spear grows heavy in your hands. It no longer wants to keep its distance: it wants to crush. You received the Overlord Spear Scroll.
passive.murimblock.conquerors_weight.des: Epic Fight's spear strikes. Each one that lands adds a charge of Domination (5 at most, lost after 4 s without a hit). At 5, your next strike is a battering ram: x1.8 damage, the target's guard broken, and a shock wave splits the ground 4 blocks ahead, pushing everything back.
Epic Fight's own spear strikes. Every fifth that lands makes the next one a battering ram.
technique.murimblock.tyrants_thrust.desc: Hold to charge, let go: a thrust that releases a beam of Qi straight ahead, 5 to 8 blocks depending on the charge, through everyone in its line.
technique.murimblock.earth_splitting_swe: The spear brought down on the ground, then swept all the way round: the ground cracks in a ring of 4 blocks and every enemy in it is thrown into the air.
technique.murimblock.falling_mountain.de: Leap high toward your target (up to 8 blocks), then plant the spear as you land: a crater of 5 blocks and a shock wave. The ground comes back.
technique.murimblock.overlords_charge.de: Charge 10 blocks, carrying up to 3 enemies on the point, then crush them against the first wall, or throw them off at the end.
technique.murimblock.hundred_battles_ram: 12 thrusts in 2 seconds, each with a small burst of Qi. The last one sends the target flying.
Raise the spear to the sky: a giant spear of Qi falls on the place you look at (up to 20 blocks away). An explosion of 10 blocks, a crater that heals, everyone thrown.
technique.murimblock.breaking_the_cauldr: Tyrant's Thrust under 20% of your health: the beam becomes enormous, 3 blocks wide, twice as strong, and breaks every guard.
Sink the boats, break the cauldrons, leave yourself only victory... You discovered the secret technique Breaking the Cauldrons

Epic Fight's own spear strikes. Nothing to choose here.

technique.murimblock.crystal_barrage.des: Launch every earned dorsal crystal at your aim. Consumes the crystals while keeping Blood Crystal Form active.
technique.murimblock.blood_iceberg.desc: Strike the ground: a temple arena of blood, 45 blocks across, rises under you, walled and spired, blood pouring down its tiers, and lifts everyone on it onto its floor. In it you have Strength and Regeneration, and a blood crystal grows back every 3 seconds. It crumbles after 60 seconds. Recovers in 9 minutes.
quest.murimblock.step.crimson_peak.forms: Hold Blood Crystal Form to its end: %s/%s
item.murimblock.blood_vial.desc: Drink in combat, in the Crimson Stance: 10 blood crystals (10 gauge points, or 10 dorsal crystals in Blood Crystal Form). Fill a glass bottle in blood.
item.murimblock.blood_vial.refused: The blood answers only the Crimson Stance, in combat

death.attack.blood_crystal.item: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's blood crystal using %3$s
passive.murimblock.star_marks.desc: Dawn Day's florett thrusts, a little quicker. Every florett strike that lands puts a star on its target, seven at most; a perfect parry puts two on the attacker. With seven, the constellation is complete: your next blow bursts it, 60% harder, throwing the target off balance. Stars go out one by one after 4 seconds without a blow, and each time you are hurt you lose two on your last target.
technique.murimblock.shooting_star.desc: Crouch, then become a streak of light: you cross 8 blocks straight ahead in an instant. Every enemy on the way is cut and takes a star; one that already carries seven bursts as you pass. From the air, the streak dives to the ground.
Dawn Day's florett thrusts, a little quicker. Each one that lands puts a star on its target; seven make a constellation that your next blow bursts. Nothing to choose here.
technique.murimblock.dipper_steps.desc: Bound three times round an enemy within 4.5 blocks, a thrust at each bound, and end behind it; no blow in melee can touch you while you bound. Against an enemy carrying four stars or more, a fourth bound. Each thrust puts a star.
technique.murimblock.orbiting_stars.desc: Raise the blade before your face: seven stars circle you for 6 seconds. Each stops one blow or projectile, whatever it is, and strikes back at its author, marking it. Those left at the end fly to the nearest marked enemies, a star each.
Point the blade at the sky: every enemy carrying your stars within 12 blocks is linked by lines of light, then all their stars burst at once, each star a quarter of your attack. Every enemy burst takes a second off Shooting Star.
technique.murimblock.falling_star_rain.d: Raise the florett to the sky: a circle appears where you look, up to 12 blocks away, and seven falling stars come down into it, the marked enemies first. Each puts a star; an enemy reaching seven under the rain bursts by itself.
technique.murimblock.seven_stars_array.d: Plant your florett: seven swords of light rise round an enemy within 10 blocks, laid out as the Big Dipper, and hold it still. They strike one after the other, then all together, harder for every star it carries.
technique.murimblock.polaris_riposte.des: A florett strike right after a perfect parry, on the one you parried: a fifth harder, and its constellation is completed at once.
technique.murimblock.polaris_riposte.dis: The pole star does not move; everything turns around it... You discovered the secret technique Polaris Riposte
quest.murimblock.step.walk_the_dipper.fi: Dipper Steps ended with a blow in the back: %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.bind_the_sky.group: Constellation Links bursting three enemies or more: %s/%s
technique.murimblock.cast.no_greatsword: %s needs a greatsword in both hands
passive.murimblock.rolling_drums.desc: Epic Fight's greatsword strikes. Every strike that lands beats a thunder drum: three beats fill a drum, three drums at most; a perfect parry beats twice. Each technique beats a full drum if you have one, and becomes its thunder version. While you swing and while a technique plays, you cannot be staggered or pushed. The chain's last strike, a drum full, lets go a small discharge. Under a real thunderstorm, out in the open, every beat counts double. The beats fade after 8 seconds without a blow.
Epic Fight's greatsword strikes, heavy and unshaken. Each one that lands beats a thunder drum; your techniques spend full drums to call the lightning. Nothing to choose here.
technique.murimblock.thunder_descends.de: Leap at the enemy you look at, up to 7 blocks, the saber raised in both hands, and bring it down where you land: the target is struck hard and a shockwave throws the others back. Thunder: a purple bolt strikes the spot first, the wave reaches farther and electrifies everyone it touches.
technique.murimblock.rolling_thunder.des: The saber held level, arms out: two full turns while you advance 3 blocks, each striking everyone around and pulling them in. Thunder: at each turn, arcs of lightning leap to the enemies within 6 blocks, from one electrified body to the next.
technique.murimblock.heavens_drum.desc: Hold: the saber planted point down, a drum of lightning round you. Every blow and projectile from the front is stopped and beats a drum. Let go: you strike the pommel, and a discharge hits everyone around, stronger for each blow stopped. 3 seconds at most, 5 Qi a second. Thunder: the discharge electrifies.
technique.murimblock.severing_flash.desc: Hold to charge, the saber wound low behind you (1.5 seconds at most); let go for a single level cut that sends a cutting wave 12 blocks ahead, harder the longer you charged. It stops at a wall and after three bodies. Thunder: a crescent of lightning that goes through everything, and hits the electrified harder.
Raise the saber to the sky: the thunder seal lights up where you look, up to 14 blocks away, and a storm gathers over it. Six bolts strike, one more for each drum you spend (it spends them all), the electrified first. The last strikes your saber: you bring it down, and a column of lightning falls on the circle.
technique.murimblock.thunder_sovereign.d: Plant your saber and let the purple lightning strike you. For 8 seconds your drums stay full, every technique is its thunder version and every strike calls a bolt on its target. At the end, a colossal bolt falls on the nearest enemy.
technique.murimblock.heaven_answers.desc: A saber strike right after a perfect parry, on the one you parried: harder, the sky opens over them and a bolt falls on them, and a drum fills at once.
technique.murimblock.heaven_answers.disc: Thunder does not ask. It answers... You discovered the secret technique Heaven Answers
quest.murimblock.step.call_down_sky.flas: Severing Flashes cutting three electrified enemies: %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.sovereign_path.bol: Enemies struck by the bolts of the storm: %s/%s
message.murimblock.star_peak.stars: On the roof of the world, the seven stars turn above you. Stay seated
message.murimblock.star_peak.silent: The stars stay silent: they answer no one below %s
message.murimblock.star_peak.again: The seven stars have already answered you
message.murimblock.star_peak.gift: The seven stars come down to you: the Seven Stars Sword Manual and its florett lie in your hands
passive.murimblock.bell_palms.desc: Epic Fight's bare-hand strikes, nothing more: all of this art is in its golden form and its techniques.
Epic Fight's bare-hand strikes. This art has no passive: it is all in its golden form. Nothing to choose here.
technique.murimblock.golden_bell.desc: Join your palms: a bell of light comes down on you and your body turns to gold, as long as you keep the form. 15 Qi, then 4 a second; press again to leave it. In it you take 40% less damage and nothing pushes you, and your other techniques change. When it ends the bell rings, pushing back everyone near, harder for every blow you took in it.
technique.murimblock.iron_rebound.desc: Your body turns to iron, palm out, for one second: the next blow in melee is sent back whole to whoever struck it, pushed back and thrown off balance. Missed, it is ready sooner. In the golden form (Golden Rebound): two seconds, sent back half as hard again, and arrows are sent back to their archer.
technique.murimblock.rooted_mountain.des: Your body turns to stone in a deep stance for 4 seconds: nothing moves you, throws you or knocks you down, and you heal 1 health a second; you cannot walk or strike, but you can guard. In the golden form (Golden Mountain): 2 health a second, and every blow you take rings the bell at its author.
technique.murimblock.bell_toll.desc: A perfect parry in the golden form: the bell rings at once and knocks the attacker down. The form goes on.
technique.murimblock.bell_toll.discovere: A bell struck hard enough answers... You discovered the secret technique Bell Toll
quest.murimblock.step.take_the_blow.blow: Blows taken in the golden form: %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.return_it.blows: Blows sent back by Iron Rebound: %s/%s
message.murimblock.thunder_calling.gathe: The storm turns toward you. Hold your blade high...
message.murimblock.thunder_calling.silen: The storm passes you by. It answers only from %s.
message.murimblock.thunder_calling.gift: The purple lightning runs through you without burning. Thunder does not ask: it answers. You received the Purple Heaven Thunder Saber Manual.

alchemy.murimblock.passive.fortune_pill: Luck smiles on you; villagers honour you
alchemy.murimblock.passive.diamond_body_: A body like diamond: little hurts you
alchemy.murimblock.passive.phoenix_rebir: Flames mend you and do not burn you
alchemy.murimblock.passive.heavenly_tige: The might of a heavenly tiger
alchemy.murimblock.passive.dragon_breath: Your Qi pours back, your mind clears
passive.murimblock.devouring_hunger.desc: In combat, bare-handed, your kagune comes out of your back: four red tentacles. Every blow you land or take feeds your Fury, the ring of blood round your dantian. Full, you become the demon: two centipedes and a mask, on all fours, faster, striking harder and taking less, and every technique changes. The Fury drains in that form; spent, you are yourself again, out of breath.
Epic Fight's bare-hand strikes for now; each blow feeds the Fury. Nothing to choose here.
technique.murimblock.lash.desc: Your four tentacles wind back and whip through the arc in front of you, 4.5 blocks out: every foe there is struck and thrown back. In the demon form, this key is Centipede Bite.
technique.murimblock.centipede_bite.desc: The demon form's Lash: a centipede rears up and shoots at the foe you look at, up to 7 blocks, and bites. It is slowed and dragged toward you, and you devour a fifth of the wound as health.
